Copy actual code. Not empty references.

Every button on this page copies inline SVG, HTML, CSS, React-style starter code, or a complete one-file template. This is meant for direct paste into your apps and pages.

Use order

1. Copy Drop-in CSS. 2. Copy a component or icon. 3. Paste into your app. Or use a one-file template and edit the words.
